title: Genotypic HIV Coreceptor Tropism Assay
author: Maurizio Zazzi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jmnck5e
materials: Depending on which kind of sample you have to analyze, extract DNA from whole blood by using the High Pure Viral Nucleic Acid Kit (Roche Applied Science, catalogue number 11858874001) OR extract RNA from plasma by using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalogue number 52904).

steps.title: Reverse transcription of plasma RNA
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat 20 µL RNA extract at 70 °C for 5 min. Add 6 µL Improm II 5× Reaction Buffer (Promega), 4 µL 1.25 mM each dNTP, 1.8 µL MgCl₂, 1 µL 50 ng/µL random hexanucleotides (Promega), 0.5 µL RNasin RNase inhibitor, and 1 µL Improm II Reverse Transcriptase (Promega). Mix and run at 37 °C for 45 min, then 80 °C for 5 min, and hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: First PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL PCR mix: add 5 µL RT reaction (or 2–5 µL DNA extract from whole blood), 28 µL distilled water, 10 µL 5× Colorless GoTaq Flexi Buffer, 3.2 µL 1.25 mM each dNTP, 0.2 µL 5 U/µL GoTaq Hot‑Start Polymerase (Promega), 5 µL 25 mM MgCl₂, and 0.6 µL 10 pmol/µL each primer P150 (5'-AATGTCAGCACAGTACAATGYACACAT-3') and P151 (5'-CTACTTTATATTTATATAATTCAYTTCTC-3'). Perform 25 cycles of 49 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 50 s, 93 °C for 30 s, then a final extension at 50 °C for 1 min and 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Second PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare a 30 µL PCR mix: add 1 µL of the first‑PCR product, 18 µL distilled water, 6 µL 5× Colorless GoTaq Flexi Buffer, 0.8 µL 1.25 mM each dNTP, 0.2 µL 5 U/µL GoTaq Hot‑Start Polymerase (Promega), 3 µL 25 mM MgCl₂, and 0.3 µL 10 pmol/µL each primer P537 (5'-CAGTACARTGYACACATGGAAT-3') and P538 (5'-TAGAAAAATTCYCCTCYACAATTAAA-3'). Run 25 cycles at 49 °C for 30 s, 72 °C for 50 s, 93 °C for 30 s, followed by a final extension at 50 °C for 1 min and 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Agarose gel visualization
steps.instruction: Load 5 µL of the second‑PCR mixture onto a 1.5 % standard agarose gel. Run electrophoresis at 5–10 V/cm for 20–40 min, stain with ethidium bromide or an equivalent DNA stain, and visually confirm the expected 421‑bp band.

steps.title: Dilute PCR product for sequencing
steps.instruction: Dilute the second‑PCR product to a concentration of 1–2 ng/µL (typically a 1/50 to 1/200 dilution). If the dilution factor exceeds 20, purification is not required; otherwise, purify the product with any suitable method before sequencing.

steps.title: Set up cycle sequencing reactions
steps.instruction: For each primer (P537 and P538), prepare a 10–15 µL sequencing reaction containing 3 µL of the diluted (or purified) PCR product and BigDye™ Terminator v1.1 or v3.1 (or equivalent). Cycle 25 times: 96 °C for 10 s, 50 °C for 5 s, 60 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Purify sequencing products and run capillary electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Purify the completed sequencing reactions to remove unincorporated labeled ddNTPs (recommended: BigDye X‑terminator purification). Load the purified products onto a capillary electrophoresis instrument of choice and run according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Analyze sequences and infer coreceptor usage
steps.instruction: Process the raw sequencing files with any suitable software, edit the contig to obtain a ~370 bp sequence free of primer ends, and submit this sequence to the geno2pheno server using a chosen false‑positive‑rate threshold to determine whether the virus uses CCR5 or CXCR4.
